import (

func TestLoomSetKeyWireExport(t *testing.T) {
	c, _ := expressionProtocolTestCompile(t)
	require.Equal(t, int64(126), defines.MORPCLatestVersion)
	for _, typ := range []types.T{types.T_float32, types.T_float64} {
		arg := plan2.GetColExpr(typ.ToType().PlanType(), 0, 0)
		key, err := plan2.BindFuncExprImplByPlanExpr(c.proc.Ctx, "set_operation_float_key", []*planpb.Expr{arg})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		id, _ := function.DecodeOverloadID(key.GetF().Func.Obj)
		require.Equal(t, int32(603), id)
		control, err := plan2.BindFuncExprImplByPlanExpr(c.proc.Ctx, "abs", []*planpb.Expr{arg})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		division, err := plan2.BindFuncExprImplByPlanExpr(c.proc.Ctx, "div", []*planpb.Expr{plan2.GetColExpr(types.New(types.T_decimal64, 10, 3).PlanType(), 0, 0), plan2.GetColExpr(types.T_uint64.ToType().PlanType(), 0, 1)})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		temporal, err := plan2.BindFuncExprImplByPlanExpr(c.proc.Ctx, "timestamp", []*planpb.Expr{plan2.GetColExpr(types.T_datetime.ToTypeWithScale(3).PlanType(), 0, 3)})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		second, err := plan2.BindFuncExprImplByPlanExpr(c.proc.Ctx, "timestampadd_second_interval", []*planpb.Expr{plan2.GetColExpr(types.New(types.T_decimal64, 18, 7).PlanType(), 0, 4)})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		load, err := plan2.BindFuncExprImplByPlanExpr(c.proc.Ctx, "_load_fk_ignore_check", []*planpb.Expr{plan2.GetColExpr(types.T_bool.ToType().PlanType(), 0, 5)})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		p := &pipeline.Pipeline{InstructionList: []*pipeline.Instruction{{ProjectList: []*planpb.Expr{key, control, division, temporal, second, load}}}}
		data, err := p.Marshal()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("MO_LOOM_PROBE_DIR"), typ.String()+".wire"), data, 0600))
		t.Logf("candidate bound %s overload=%d bytes=%d", typ, key.GetF().Func.Obj, len(data))
	}
}
func TestLoomObservedMainWorkerExclusion(t *testing.T) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("MO_LOOM_PROBE_DIR"), "main-response.wire"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var response query.Response
	require.NoError(t, response.Unmarshal(data))
	require.Equal(t, int64(125), response.GetProtocolVersion.Version)
	for _, typ := range []types.T{types.T_float32, types.T_float64} {
		t.Run(typ.String(), func(t *testing.T) {
			c, client := expressionProtocolTestCompile(t)
			data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("MO_LOOM_PROBE_DIR"), typ.String()+".wire"))
			require.NoError(t, err)
			var p pipeline.Pipeline
			require.NoError(t, p.Unmarshal(data))
			expr := p.InstructionList[0].ProjectList[0]
			client.customResponse = true
			client.response = &response
			c.execType = plan2.ExecTypeAP_MULTICN
			c.cnList = engine.Nodes{{Id: "old-worker", Addr: "remote:6001", Mcpu: 4}}
			require.NoError(t, c.constrainRemoteExpressionWorkers(&planpb.Query{Nodes: []*planpb.Node{{PhysicalEqualityKeyList: []*planpb.Expr{expr}}}, Steps: []int32{0}}))
			require.Equal(t, plan2.ExecTypeAP_ONECN, c.execType)
			op := projection.NewArgument()
			defer op.Release()
			op.ProjectList = []*planpb.Expr{expr}
			scope := &Scope{Magic: Remote, Proc: c.proc, NodeInfo: engine.Node{Id: "old-worker", Addr: "remote:6001"}, RootOp: op}
			encoded, err := encodeRemoteScope(scope, c.proc)
			require.ErrorContains(t, err, "version 126")
			require.Nil(t, encoded)
			require.Positive(t, client.calls)
			require.Equal(t, client.calls, client.releases)
			t.Logf("actual official response version=%d placement=coordinator sendErr=%v", response.GetProtocolVersion.Version, err)
		})
	}
}

package compile

import (
	"github.com/matrixorigin/matrixone/pkg/container/types"

)

func TestLoomOfficialMain125MissingSetKey(t *testing.T) {
	require.Equal(t, int64(125), defines.MORPCLatestVersion)
	c, _ := expressionProtocolTestCompile(t)
	for _, typ := range []types.T{types.T_float32, types.T_float64} {
		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("MO_LOOM_PROBE_DIR"), typ.String()+".wire"))
		require.NoError(t, err)
		var p pipeline.Pipeline
		require.NoError(t, p.Unmarshal(data))
		key, control := p.InstructionList[0].ProjectList[0], p.InstructionList[0].ProjectList[1]
		_, exists := function.GetFunctionByIdWithoutError(key.GetF().Func.Obj)
		require.False(t, exists)
		require.NoError(t, validateRemoteExpressionPipelineProtocol(c.proc, &p))
		native, err := colexec.NewExpressionExecutor(c.proc, control)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		native.Free()
		divNative, divErr := colexec.NewExpressionExecutor(c.proc, p.InstructionList[0].ProjectList[2])
		require.NoError(t, divErr)
		divNative.Free()
		temporalNative, temporalErr := colexec.NewExpressionExecutor(c.proc, p.InstructionList[0].ProjectList[3])
		require.NoError(t, temporalErr)
		temporalNative.Free()
		second := p.InstructionList[0].ProjectList[4]
		id, _ := function.DecodeOverloadID(second.GetF().Func.Obj)
		require.Equal(t, int32(601), id)
		normalizer, normalizerErr := colexec.NewExpressionExecutor(c.proc, second)
		require.NoError(t, normalizerErr)
		normalizer.Free()
		load := p.InstructionList[0].ProjectList[5]
		loadID, _ := function.DecodeOverloadID(load.GetF().Func.Obj)
		require.Equal(t, int32(602), loadID)
		loadFeatures, loadErr := planpb.RequiredRemoteExpressionFeatures(load)
		require.NoError(t, loadErr)
		require.True(t, loadFeatures.LoadFKIgnoreCheck)
		loadNative, loadErr := colexec.NewExpressionExecutor(c.proc, load)
		require.NoError(t, loadErr)
		loadNative.Free()
		keyID, _ := function.DecodeOverloadID(key.GetF().Func.Obj)
		require.Equal(t, int32(603), keyID)
		native, err = colexec.NewExpressionExecutor(c.proc, key)
		require.Nil(t, native)
		require.ErrorContains(t, err, "function overload id not found")
		t.Logf("official version=%d type=%s wireAdmission=accepted function603=false ordinaryControl=constructed keyErr=%v", defines.MORPCLatestVersion, typ, err)
	}
}
